title: Creamy Potato Casserole
description: A comforting, creamy casserole made with potatoes, gooey cheese, and a crispy topping.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine sliced potatoes, melted butter, warm milk, cocoa powder (if using), salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Transfer the potato mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle shredded cheese evenly over the top of the potatoes.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
